overlapCheck.method: exact trimmed text and id comparison against all four prior sets, asserted at build time with a throw

A_independent.authoredBy: an earlier programme phase; never executed against any Level-3 code
A_independent.selection: deterministic -- indices where i % 5 === 4 over the id-sorted dataset
A_independent.disjointFromPriorStrides: L3-2b used i % 5 === 0 and L3-2c used i % 5 === 2; the three strides are pairwise disjoint by construction
A_independent.coverageLimitation: this dataset is periodic with period 5, so EVERY stride-of-5 selection yields exactly two hazard families. No single-stride rule over this source can do better. Strides 1 and 3 (fall_protection, mobile_equipment) remain entirely unused.

B_authoredComplement.why: source A is entirely positive hazards and contains no negative control, corrected or controlled state, subjective wording, clarification case, or case where a clarification must be WITHHELD -- which is the whole subject of L3-2d
B_authoredComplement.limitation: authored by the implementer -- the weakest provenance in this set, and the third phase running to carry it. Mitigated: written and frozen BEFORE the repair code was written, expectations and clarification labels declared here rather than derived from a run, and no text reused from any prior set.

clarificationLabelContract.true_means: a decision-critical fact is missing and the correct semantic conclusion cannot be reached safely without it
clarificationLabelContract.false_means: the evidence already supports the semantic conclusion; a question would only add optional detail and is noise
clarificationLabelContract.decisionIsMade: recorded per scenario so D1 can be measured directly: a scenario with decisionIsMade true must carry NO clarification
